title: Signal Lab: UI rollout + telemetry deep-dive (notes)
content:
Context
- Working notes from a cross-functional standup focused on the Signal Lab experiment and the next UI rollout wave (Panel Cascade v0 -> v1).
- Purpose: capture telemetry gaps, make deployment decisions for canary cohort, and map action items for instrumentation.
- Date/time: 2027-04-06 10:00-10:45 PT (standing)
- Attendees (actual): Anjali P. (notes), Liam C., Rocio A., Ethan P., Marina D., Priya (analytics - joined for 20m), Noah (sre - joined).

Quick summary / TL;DR
- Frontend: Panel Cascade v1 widget ready behind feature flag; small CSS regressions noted on narrow screens. Will push to canary if analytics checks pass.
- Analytics: Event surface looks OK but missing a reliable client_id mapping for shadow traffic -> need shim.
- Instrumentation: fast-fetch-cache headers not included in some server-side render paths; patch queued PR (link above).
- Rollout decision: proceed with 5% canary but gate by two automated checks (latency SLO and conversion delta).

Notes from each area
- Frontend (Liam):
  - Implemented panel-cascade layout with progressive hydration. Local perf numbers: initial paint down 120ms for happy path.
  - Known issues: overflow in mobile when user has long org names; CSS fix scoped and ready.
  - Integration: uses new fast-fetch API (feature flag: ff-panel-cascade). Need backend header to be present (see instrumentation).
  - TODO: add QA checklist in the PR description (Liam).

- Analytics / Signal Lab (Rocio + Priya):
  - Current experiment id: SL-2027-04-01-A. Tracking events are firing for client interactions but missing stable identity for shadow traffic. That skews baseline.
  - Suggested fix: attach session fingerprint (sha256 of ip+ua salt) as a non-PHI id when KMS approved. Privacy check with legal pending.
  - Metrics to monitor for canary: time-to-first-interaction (TTFI), panel-open-rate, error-rate, downstream-op latency.
  - Quick query snippets (notes to self):
    - PANEL_OPEN: select count(*) where event='panel_open' and experiment='SL-2027-04-01-A'
    - TTFI P50/P95: group by cohort, compare to baseline_last_7d

- Instrumentation (Ethan):
  - Root cause for missing headers: server-side pre-render path bypasses middleware that injects fast-fetch-cache and client_id. Repro in staging.
  - Patch: PR #987 adds middleware and unit tests. Deployed to staging; manual smoke looks fine.
  - Concern: adding middleware adds ~1ms median to SSR pipeline; SRE flagged. Need perf baseline after deploy.

- Rollouts / SRE (Marina + Noah):
  - Canary plan: 5% of traffic in prod region us-west1 for 48 hours. Gate thresholds: 5% increase in error-rate or >8% increase in p95 render latency -> automatic rollback.
  - Fallback: immediate fallback to Panel v0 via feature flag switch; toggle documented in runbook.
  - Observability: dashboards created in rollout namespace (links in linked_artifacts). Alert thresholds config under ROLL-402.

Decisions made
- Proceed with 5% canary on 2027-04-07 08:00 PT provided the staging smoke and analytics mapping fix are merged.
- Use session fingerprint (non-PII) as intermediary identity for analytics until KMS-approved client_id rollout; document retention policy.
- Keep middleware perf change but run a micro-benchmark pre/post production deploy; SRE to compare within 24h of canary start.

Open questions / blockers
- Legal sign-off on using session fingerprint method for shadow traffic (Rocio to ping Legal).
- Does the middleware change break any 3rd-party CDN caching rules? (Marina to validate with infra).
- We still have flaky e2e where panel open event is emitted twice for a back-button bounce. Need repro.

Action items (owners + ETA)
- Liam: add QA checklist + screenshots to PR #987 and include mobile regression note. ETA: 2027-04-06 EOD.
- Ethan: merge middleware PR after one more unit test and deploy to staging. ETA: 2027-04-06 noon.
- Rocio: draft privacy note and open legal ticket for session fingerprint approach. ETA: 2027-04-06 EOD.
- Marina: validate CDN header interactions and update runbook if any cache invalidation is required. ETA: 2027-04-06 18:00 PT.
- Noah/SRE: schedule micro-benchmark (5 runs) pre/post middleware deploy and post-canary. ETA: measurements by 2027-04-08.
- Anjali: consolidate this doc and post to #console-rollouts with a exec summary. ETA: 2027-04-06 morning.

Brainstorm / notes to self (informal)
- If we can surface client_id in an encrypted header, downstream analytics will be cleaner. Might pair with pipeline team next quarter.
- Could use a quick canary variant that only enables Panel Cascade CSS without hydration to isolate hydration regressions. Worth a smoke test.
- Consider adding a debug flag that logs only to staging (to avoid noise) for two days to capture the duplicate event case.

Retrospective hooks for post-canary
- Did session fingerprint materially reduce noise vs shadow-traffic without identity?
- Were rollback triggers tuned appropriately? False positives?
- Measure cost impact of middleware + additional trace spans.

Misc references / links (working)
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/987
- Rollout ticket: ROLL-402 (linked in jira)
- Experiment dashboard: onboarding in Analytics > Signal Lab > SL-2027-04-01-A
- Slack thread: #console-rollouts (thread ts: 168052)
